        <h1 class='oc-page-title '>Latest from the library: newsletter July 2026</h1>
        <p class="published-on small-text">Published on 09 July 2026</p>
        
       <picture>
  <source media="(min-width: 992px)" srcset="/files/assets/libraries/v/1/news/2026-fanmail-news-generic.jpg?dimension=pageimage&w=480">
  <source media="(min-width: 768px)" srcset="/files/assets/libraries/v/1/news/2026-fanmail-news-generic.jpg?dimension=pageimage&w=480">

  <img class="main-page-image" src="/files/assets/libraries/v/1/news/2026-fanmail-news-generic.jpg?dimension=pageimage&w=480" alt="The image says Fanmail newsletter, with a bright pink and white background. Line art drawings of a fantail, an envelope, the email symbol and a newspaper are included." />
</picture> 
      
        <p><strong>Welcome to the July 2026 issue of Fanmail, our bi-monthly newsletter at Upper Hutt Libraries.</strong></p>
<p>Fanmail brings you quick-read updates on what's happening at your library, from new services and collection changes to a fantastic range of community events and resources for all ages.</p>
<h2>In this issue...</h2>
<ul>
<li>Libraries Manager, Denise Clarkson, shares some impressive data about the success of <a href="https://www.upperhuttlibrary.co.nz/news/welcome-to-SMART" target="_self">our recent move to the SMART library network</a>;</li>
<li>we take the road less travelled and step into the wilderness of words at our annual <a href="https://www.upperhuttlibrary.co.nz/whats-on/poetry" target="_self">Poetry Competition</a>;</li>
<li>you're invited to explore Upper Hutt's past with the <em>Upper Hutt Leader</em> online archive;</li>
<li>and we look forward to hosting another fun-packed <a href="https://www.upperhutt.govt.nz/community/u-play" target="_blank">U-PLAY school holiday programme</a>.</li>
</ul>
<p><a href="https://mailchi.mp/uhcc/fanmail-july-2026" target="_blank"><strong>Read the July issue of Fanmail</strong></a><strong>.</strong></p>
<h2>Keen to join the fan club?</h2>
<p>Get the latest library news straight to your inbox, every two months. Event notices, first looks at new resources, and important updates all rolled into one handy email newsletter.</p>
<p><a href="https://mailchi.mp/uhcc/fanmail-subscription" target="_blank" class="styled-button">Subscribe to the newsletter</a></p>
